name: os_menu
description: Open or close the Albie menu, where the user finds their tools, projects and artifacts. Without open it toggles.

open.description: true opens the menu, false closes it

name: os_tab
description: Show one tab of the Albie menu (opens the menu if it is closed): tools, projects or artifacts.

name: os_open
description: Open something from the Albie menu by kind and id. Tool ids: cad, code, train, notebook, drive, messages, gestures. Project ids like proj_truck. System pages: agents, settings, build. Works at the desk and away from it. Returns an error if there is no such thing.

id.description: the id of the tool, project, artifact or system page

name: os_windows
description: Manage the user's open windows. recenter brings every window back in front of the user, side by side. close_all closes them all.
